messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync—next release train is scheduled for Wed 09:00 PT (canary window 09:00-10:00). We need owners for frontend, runtime, and infra smoke checks. Who's taking what? Also need rollback ready and canary traffic split set to 10%.

Jared Kim: I can own runtime smoke and watch latency dashboards. Will be around 08:30-10:30 PT.

Priya Rao: I'll take frontend smoke (sanity on js bundle + e2e). Ping me when frontend slot is live.

Sam (oncall): I can handle infra/gpu pools, autoscale checks, and rollback ability. If someone can post the rollback command I can rehearse it.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: release-train-2024-07-10 assigned slot Wed 09:00 PT. Reminder: attach canary policy.

Chris L.: Quick note: runtime owner, please validate KV cache warmup before canary. Last time cold cache added ~300ms.

Maya Patel: Thanks. For rollback, use `infra rollback --slot=release-train-2024-07-10 --to=previous` (confirming with infra) — Sam please test and ACK.

Sam (oncall): ACK. I'll run a dry-run at 08:45 PT and paste output.

Jared Kim: Also opening a tiny PR to set canary=10% and disable prefetch for this train — link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234

Priya Rao: Frontend smoke checklist: ```
- visit /app
- perform login
- run quick search
- open model status modal
- verify error rates < 0.5%
```

Maya Patel: Awesome. Owners: frontend=Priya, runtime=Jared, infra=Sam. I'll act as release steward. If no objections by EOD, we'll lock.

Chris L.: No objections. :thumbsup:

Sam (oncall): Dry-run passed, logged at https://deployments.redwood.ai/logs/1719999999-dryrun — rollback command executed successfully.

Maya Patel: Great — leaving a final note: if any smoke fails, hit `abort-slot` in infra console and notify #eng-releases + oncall. Thanks everyone.
